'''Argon Doehn''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Doehn fought in the [[Battle of Miztoc City|battle]] of [[Miztoc City]], when they were offered assistance from [[Mygo Skinto]]. Without Skinto's help, [[Miztoc]] would have remained in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] hands.
